provenance.verifiedAgainstCode: NO. A search of every tracked Python file found no SWBRA function, no weights, and no IL-6/CRP/IgA/protein fields. The desktop model consumes 14 lifestyle/pH features only (main.py:35-41).

pH.unit: per README, salivary pH; the desktop collects gastric pH readings labelled 'GASTRIC pH'

Protein.role: listed as an input in README.md:45
Protein.note: No documented weight. It must contribute 0 unless a validated source supplies one.

scoreComposition: Sum of triggered weights. The documented weights sum to 90; protein has no documented weight.
boundaryOperators: Inclusive integer bands per README.md:73-75. Score 39 is LOW, 40 is MODERATE, 69 is MODERATE, 70 is HIGH.
implementationNotes: The documented arithmetic is testable from boolean flags (see flagsApi). Scoring raw biomarker values is disabled because no validated threshold, operator, unit, or missing-value rule exists in the source. The Android and desktop result screens must show SWBRA as unavailable rather than inventing a score.

flagsApi.purpose: Test the documented weights and bands without inventing raw-value thresholds.
flagsApi.note: These flags are not exposed in the app UI because the app does not collect the underlying biomarkers.

confidence.weights: VERIFIED against README text only; not implemented in code.
confidence.bands: VERIFIED against README text only; not implemented in code.
